title: Penetration
text:
Resistance Penetration is the ability for hits to treat the target's resistance as if it was lowered by the specified amount.


== Mechanics ==
Penetration causes the specified amount to be subtracted from the target's corresponding resistance when determining the damage they take from a hit, to a minimum of 0% resistance by default.
Penetration is calculated after accounting for other modifiers that raise or lower the target's resistances and their maximum capped resistances.
